chapter: Family, Margaret's story and Eutris's memories
title: Other acts at the Eighty-One: Ma Rainey, Ethel Waters
summary: He heard Ma Rainey there; he cannot recall other bands or Frank Johnson from then.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Were you in Morris Brown then? You were still in Morris Brown?
Yes, in and out.
He was there in '21 and '22 I know because he was there when I came here and I came here in '23, I mean in Cleveland.
So, can you remember anybody else at the Eighty-One and Ninety-One?
Ethel Waters.
Ethel Waters. But you said - you don't remember her?
I don't remember her.
You said something about Ma Rainey. I was wondering if
/Ma Rainey had traveled on that TOBA circuit?
I heard her, that's right. I heard her at the Eighty-One...
She was earlier.
Do you remember anyone else in the other bands - King Oliver, Bunk Johnson - that come through there at that time?
No, but I know Bunk Johnson.
But I mean not at that particular time?
No, I didn't know anything about him then.
You played with the bands at the Eighty-One and Ninety-One, right?
Beg pardon?
You played there?
Yes, he played there.
Would you describe what the band was like and some of the people that may have been in the band?
I didn't know anything about Frank Johnson until I came to New York and they sent for him to come -
He said the band that was playing at Eighty-One. Do you remember any of the people that were in it?
No.
